scripts.deploy: docker compose --env-file .env.r2 -f compose.r2.yaml build deploy && docker compose --env-file .env.r2 -f compose.r2.yaml run --rm deploy
scripts.oci:deploy: docker compose --env-file .env.oci -f compose.oci.yaml build deploy && docker compose --env-file .env.oci -f compose.oci.yaml run --rm --no-deps deploy
scripts.oci:start: docker compose --env-file .env.oci -f compose.oci.yaml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180 app caddy
scripts.oci:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.oci -f compose.oci.yaml logs -f app caddy
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/client/.assetsignore', { force: true })"
